[code][Post Wedding Dates] This mod failed in the GameLoop.DayEnding event. Technical details:
NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.
   at PostWeddingDates.ModEntry.OnDayEnded(Object sender, EventArgs e) in C:UsersBlamssourcereposPostWeddingDatesPostWeddingDatesModEntry.cs:line 77

This fix injects a:

[code]if (not married):
do nothing[/code]
before the things the mod tries to do.

Originally wanted to send a PR to the github of the mod, but is extremely outdated.
